description: This file contains the implementation of the Coupon class, which is an extension controller within the OpenCart admin module for managing coupon-related functionality. It defines methods for rendering the coupon extension page and saving coupon configuration settings.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Controller class for the coupon total extension within the OpenCart admin module, handling the display and saving of configuration settings for coupons.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Render the coupon extension configuration page, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, and including header, footer, and left column controllers.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handle saving of the coupon total extension settings, verifying permissions and returning a JSON response indicating success or error.
